purpose: Authoritative-vendor evidence delta adding VKS and Augmentir as connected-worker/frontline manufacturing integration targets and promoting Arena PLM from discovery to spec verification. Reuses existing REST, webhook, OData and vendor-thin profiles; no credentials, customer data, writes, agent actions or plant-network/control surfaces were used. Hybrid/on-prem VKS remains fail-closed to the customer edge.

patch.evidenceNote: Arena's current Developer Platform documents RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, SSO, webhooks, a Data Extract Service, a low-code integration engine/event queue, and Arena Connect. The public v1 Swagger exposes resource-oriented REST endpoints for items, revisions, BOMs, changes, quality, training, files and outbound events and requires an Arena access/session token for authenticated calls. The same API surface supports CRUD and outbound-integration administration, so WFM reuses the existing REST and signed-event profiles but remains GET/read-event only until an authorised tenant proves a least-privilege API identity. Arena is cloud-native, so no plant-network route is inferred.

requiredPermissions: dedicated Arena API identity limited by the customer's Arena role/workspace permissions to the approved PLM/QMS objects
read access to items, revisions, BOM/change, quality, training and supplier/product records needed by WFM
read-only access to outbound-event data or a customer-approved webhook subscription; no outbound-integration administration
no create/update/delete, import commit, workflow approval, automation administration or Arena Connect flow-edit authority
dataAvailableOrExpected: items, revisions, bills of material, sourcing/supplier and compliance context
engineering changes, requests, projects and lifecycle state
quality processes including CAPA/nonconformance-related product context where licensed
training relationships/evidence attached to controlled product records where exposed
files/attachments metadata and outbound events for approved change notifications
automationOpportunities: flag workforce plans when a released engineering/BOM change alters the skills, training or work-instruction readiness needed for production
use approved training evidence and product revision context to stop stale qualification assumptions before shift assignment
feed product/quality change events into labour-demand and specialist-coverage forecasts without mutating Arena
reuse Arena Connect or the event queue as a customer-managed hand-off when that reduces custom integration work, while keeping WFM action authority read-only
join quality/CAPA and change-cycle context with WFM staffing, overtime and skills data to identify labour patterns associated with rework or slow change adoption
savingsHypotheses: reduce rework and startup delay by detecting product/revision changes that require refreshed training or specialist coverage before production begins
reduce manual PLM-to-WFM administration by reusing approved Arena item, change, training and quality context
reduce schedule churn and avoidable overtime caused by late engineering-change or quality constraints
shorten implementation where Arena's Developer Platform, outbound events or Arena Connect already provide governed enterprise integration routes
dataGaps: Arena is not normally authoritative for payroll, contractual hours, absence, detailed machine state or agency-worker commercials
public documentation does not establish the exact tenant-specific API role, record scope, rate limits or event replay guarantees for a particular customer
training linked to a product record is evidence only and does not automatically confer WFM work eligibility without customer qualification policy
customer configuration determines which quality, supplier, project and custom attributes are populated and useful to workforce decisions
constraintsRisks: the REST API supports create/update/delete and import/integration administration; WFM must allowlist read routes and prove the technical identity cannot exercise mutative authority
API/session token handling and OAuth/SSO deployment details can vary; credentials must be vaulted and tenant/workspace bound
webhook/outbound-event delivery must be deduplicated, replay-bounded and reconciled with periodic reads before events affect staffing decisions
BOM/change/custom attributes evolve over time, requiring schema fingerprints and versioned customer mappings
files and quality records can contain sensitive or export-controlled content; ingest metadata/minimum fields rather than copying documents by default
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Keep Arena at spec verification. In an authorised customer workspace, prove the actual OAuth/session-token flow and least-privilege role, enumerate approved REST resources, exercise bounded read pagination and an outbound event with dedupe/reconciliation, fingerprint custom fields, and normalise only the product/change/training/quality signals needed by WFM before promoting to sandbox or tenant authentication.

systems.name: VKS Connected Worker / Human-Centric MES
systems.evidenceNote: VKS documents a REST API for ERP/MES/BI integration and Push API notifications for form completion, operation completion, quantity completion, work-order completion, non-conformance and cycle-complete events. VKS also supports SaaS and fully isolated on-prem deployments, and VKS Edge can communicate with databases, tools, sensors and PLCs. WFM therefore reuses the existing REST and webhook/event fabric but fails closed to a customer/site edge until deployment topology is proven; VKS Edge device/tool/PLC control is outside WFM authority.

requiredPermissions: dedicated VKS integration/API identity limited to the approved company/site and read-only production/form/reporting data where the product permits it
read access to work orders, operations, quantities, cycle/form/non-conformance and relevant traceability data needed by WFM
customer-approved Push API destination/event subscription for read-side notifications only
for on-prem/private deployments, route through the customer edge; no direct cloud scan of the VKS host or plant network
no guidebook mutation, work-order update, device/tool/PLC command, parameter push or VKS Edge control authority
dataAvailableOrExpected: work orders and operation status exchanged with ERP/MES integrations
completed quantities, cycle times, material usage and work-order/cycle completion events
smart-form data including customer-defined quality/non-conformance and traceability fields
serial/lot/product-history and process-compliance evidence captured during guided work where configured
guide/work-instruction execution and productivity context available in VKS reports/operations views
automationOpportunities: refresh labour demand and completion forecasts from live work-order, operation, cycle and quantity progress
detect cycle-time or non-conformance patterns that may require redeployment, extra qualified coverage or supervisor attention
correlate paid labour and skills mix with VKS cycle, completion and quality outcomes to identify overstaffing, bottlenecks and rework
use Push API events as a low-latency trigger with periodic REST reconciliation rather than high-frequency polling
reuse existing ERP/MES-to-VKS work-order context during implementation to reduce duplicate site/work-centre/order mapping
savingsHypotheses: reduce paid idle time and avoidable overtime by updating staffing decisions from actual operation/cycle progress rather than static plans
reduce rework and supervision effort by linking non-conformance/cycle evidence to the skills mix and staffing conditions that produced it
reduce manual production-to-WFM reconciliation by consuming VKS completion, quantity and form data already captured at the frontline
shorten deployment where VKS already carries the customer's ERP/MES work-order identifiers and traceability fields
dataGaps: public material confirms REST/Push integration capability but does not publish the authentication method, API version lifecycle, rate limits, pagination contract or all endpoint schemas
worker identity, qualification and training records may not be available or authoritative through the API and must not be inferred from execution data alone
payroll, contractual hours, absence and agency-commercial data remain authoritative in HCM/WFM/payroll/VMS systems
customer smart forms and work-instruction data are highly configurable and require per-tenant schema discovery/fingerprints
constraintsRisks: VKS can be SaaS or fully isolated on-prem; deployment topology must be proven before any direct-cloud route is allowed, and on-prem/private hosts stay behind the customer edge
Push notifications are event triggers rather than complete state; duplicate/out-of-order/missed events require idempotency and periodic REST reconciliation
VKS Edge can push tool parameters and communicate with PLCs/devices; WFM must not inherit device, parameter or industrial-control authority
form/attachment content may include quality, customer or regulated evidence and should be data-minimised
bidirectional ERP/MES API capability exists but writes remain disabled until separately authorised and write-roundtrip certified
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Keep VKS at spec verification and reuse the REST plus signed-event fabric. Obtain current tenant API documentation or an authorised sandbox, classify SaaS versus on-prem topology, prove a least-privilege read identity, validate pagination/rate limits and Push event authenticity/replay behaviour, fingerprint customer forms/fields and normalise work-order/operation/cycle/quality signals. Keep VKS Edge and all control/write surfaces disabled.

systems.name: Augmentir Connected Worker
systems.evidenceNote: Augmentir's official connected-worker material documents bidirectional standard connectors to ERP, CMMS, QMS, MES, CRM, HCM and LMS, pro-code extensibility, OData and APIs for reporting/integration. The platform captures skills, training, frontline work, performance, safety, quality, maintenance and asset context, and now includes agentic/GenAI actions. WFM reuses the existing OData plus vendor-thin connector profiles; authentication, scope, paging and rate-limit details remain tenant/vendor-specific and no agent action or bidirectional mutation authority is inherited.

requiredPermissions: dedicated Augmentir reporting/integration identity scoped to the approved tenant/sites and read-side OData/API data
read access only to the skills, training, worker-performance, work-execution, asset/maintenance and safety/quality signals required by WFM
no Agent Studio, Augie/agent execution, workflow mutation, content authoring, maintenance-notification write-back or enterprise connector administration
explicit customer mapping between Augmentir worker/task/site identifiers and WFM identities before data can affect staffing
dataAvailableOrExpected: skills matrix, skill gaps, training/workforce-development evidence and task-level proficiency/performance context
digital work-instruction/checklist execution and associated frontline data
worker/task productivity and execution signals used by Augmentir workforce intelligence
asset, operator-care, maintenance issue and work-history context where configured
safety, quality and non-conformance observations captured in frontline workflows
enterprise-system context already synchronized into Augmentir through standard connectors
automationOpportunities: enrich skills-based scheduling with current skill/training and task-performance evidence rather than static matrices
identify workers or teams needing targeted upskilling before shortages turn into overtime or agency demand
correlate frontline execution/performance with staffing, shift, production and quality outcomes to improve labour standards and forecasts
use asset/maintenance issue context to trigger qualified maintenance coverage or safe redeployment without letting WFM execute maintenance actions
reuse Augmentir's existing ERP/HCM/CMMS/MES connector context to reduce duplicate implementation mapping
savingsHypotheses: reduce overtime and agency use by finding skill gaps early and assigning available qualified workers more accurately
reduce time-to-proficiency and training administration by reusing current skills/training/execution evidence in workforce planning
reduce downtime and rework by linking task performance, maintenance/safety observations and staffing conditions
shorten implementation where Augmentir already reconciles worker, task, asset and enterprise-system context
dataGaps: public material does not publish the tenant authentication/scopes, OData entity catalogue, API versions, pagination, rate limits or event semantics needed for authenticated proof
Augmentir is not authoritative for payroll, contractual hours, statutory absence or agency commercials unless those are synchronized from another source
AI-derived performance/proficiency signals require customer governance and must not automatically override formal qualifications, legal eligibility or agreed labour rules
which skills, training, safety, quality, maintenance and asset fields exist depends on the customer's configured workflows and integrations
constraintsRisks: bidirectional standard connectors and pro-code extensibility exist, but WFM must remain read-only until any write path is separately certified
Augmentir's agentic AI can execute tasks and drive workflows; normal WFM integration must preserve agentActionEnabled:false and never inherit Agent Studio/Augie action authority
performance/proficiency analytics can affect workers materially and require transparent customer policy, provenance and human-governed use rather than opaque automated eligibility decisions
custom workflows and enterprise connector mappings can create schema/identity drift across sites and must be fingerprinted/versioned
valueReview.nextDevelopmentAction: Keep Augmentir at spec verification. Obtain current vendor API/OData documentation or an authorised tenant, identify authentication/scopes/entity metadata/pagination/rate limits, prove a read-only integration identity, map worker/site/task/skill identifiers, sample only approved skills/training/execution/maintenance signals, and keep all agent/workflow/write authority disabled before any evidence promotion.
